management_remarks: Q3 FY26 marked another quarter of superior execution for ICICI Bank, with Net Profit crossing Rs 12,400 Crore and Book Value per Share compounding steadily. High-margin business banking and SME working capital lines grew 19.4% year-on-year, offsetting competitive pricing in large corporate lending. Net NPA remained anchored at 0.44%, demonstrating the durability of our customer-360 risk selection framework.
analyst_qa: When asked about loan growth ceilings, management noted that system-wide credit-to-deposit constraints and volatile liquidity conditions require calibrated balance sheet expansion. We are cautious about aggressive pricing in mid-corporate segments and acknowledge headwinds in export-oriented MSME working capital demand. Sustaining NIM above 4.30% remains challenging and is subject to deposit cost stabilization.
